content.title: World Baseball Classic Highlights: USA Advances to WBC Final On Controversial Strike Call
content.text: Team USA has advanced to the World Baseball Classic final with a narrow 2-1 victory over the Dominican Republic on Sunday at LoanDepot Park.Paul Skenes, the reigning National League Cy Young Award winner, held the star-studded Dominican Republic to just one run in 4 ⅓ innings pitched. Junior Caminero scored the lone home run for the Dominican Republic. Gunnar Henderson put the U.S. on the board in the third inning to tie things up, and Roman Anthony gave it the run that earned it the win at the top of the fourth inning. Anthony's two home runs lead all Team USA players at this year's tournament.These were the top moments and highlights from Team USA vs. Dominican Republic in the World Baseball Classic semifinal game: Mar 15, 2026 - 11:24p ET Final Score: USA vs. Dominican Republic Mar 15, 2026 - 7:53p ET Skenes to A-Rod: 'Reason We Can Play These Games' MLB on FOX analyst Alex Rodriguez spoke with Paul Skenes about the importance of representing Team USA. Skenes also discussed having Air Force Academy cadets come out to support the former Falcons player during the WBC game against Mexico. The Pirates ace and NL Cy Young winner also talked what makes his trademark slider such a nightmare to opposing players. Paul Skenes takes AROD through his pitching repertoire 🇺🇸 World Baseball Classic & more! Live Coverage for this has ended Mar 15, 2026 - 11:09p ET The United States is through to the World Baseball Classic final, but not without controversy. The final strike call against Geraldo Perdomo was met with scrutiny for appearing to be outside of the strike zone.Mar 15, 2026 - 10:47p ET Soto Not Happy Juan Soto wasn't convinced that this strike three call was correct, but that didn't slow Garrett Whitlock down on his way to a 1-2-3 eighth inning to maintain Team USA's lead heading into the ninth inning.Mar 15, 2026 - 10:26p ET Another Crisis Averted For Team USA! David Bednar with a clutch inning! Two straight strikeouts to keep the lead at one for Team USA. With runners in scoring position (including Austin Wells at third and Geraldo Perdomo representing the go-ahead run at second base), the Yankees reliever sits Fernando Tatis Jr. and Ketel Marte down. Mar 15, 2026 - 9:58p ET Rogers Gets Skenes, Team USA Out Of Jam! A double play and Tyler Rogers can breathe a sigh of relief! The Blue Jays submariner gets Juan Soto to dribble a grounder to Bobby Witt Jr., who tags Ketel Marte out at second and then has an acrobatic throw to first baseman Bryce Harper. That closes the books for Team USA ace Paul Skenes too, who was responsible for the players on base. Mar 15, 2026 - 9:54p ET Skenes' Night Is Done ... … but Team USA isn't out of trouble. Tyler Rogers comes in as the reliever with Team DR having two players on base (Fernando Tatis on second and Ketel Marte on first).Skenes finishes his Team USA duties with tonight's outing, where he goes 4.1 innings pitched with one run given up (the homer to Junior Caminero). The Pirates ace struck out two while giving up six hits on the night. Mar 15, 2026 - 9:41p ET WEB GEM! J-Rod Robs Aaron Judge of HR! Julio Rodriguez climbs the ladder and absolutely makes a spectacular catch to take away a home run from Aaron Judge! What a catch by the Mariners center fielder there to rob a dingier from the Yankees superstar.Dominican Republic’s Julio Rodríguez ROBS Aaron Judge of a home run Dominican Republic’s Julio Rodríguez robbed Aaron Judge of a home run to keep the score 2-1 against the United States Mar 15, 2026 - 9:14p ET USA Leads! Roman Anthony Hits HR And Team USA takes the lead with Boston Red Sox star Roman Anthony hitting a solo shot off reliever Gregory Soto! That's two homers in this inning after Gunnar Henderson's HR off star Luis Severino and USA is on top now. It's now two homers each for Anthony and Henderson at the tournament. Gunnar Henderson and Roman Anthony hit home runs to give the United States the lead over the Dominican Republic Mar 15, 2026 - 9:11p ET GUNNAR! We're Tied in Miami Gunnar Henderson goes yard of Luis Severino! We're tied a one here in Miami! The Orioles star second baseman has done well against Severino, who is 7-for-9 with a home run in his MLB career against the A's pitcher. That also ends Severino's evening, who had an otherwise stellar outing with 3 ⅓ innings. A deserved tip of the cap for the Dominican pitcher, who struck out six and walked none tonight. Mar 15, 2026 - 8:55p ET Severino Is Sittin' 'Em Down That's SIX strikeouts through three innings of work for Dominican Republic pitcher Luis Servino. Two of the those K's in the top of the third came on Kyle Schwarber and Aaron Judge. The A's pitcher has been doing his part against Team USA's lineup, having given up four hits but keeping the shutout alive in Miami. Mar 15, 2026 - 8:41p ET Junior Caminero Home Run! Team D.R. Leads Junior Caminero continues his torrid streak at the WBC, homering to left center field and giving the Dominican Republic an early lead. The crowd in Miami absolutely goes bonkers with that shot. That's three home runs at the tournament for the Tampa Bay Rays star, and 15 overall for the Dominicans. That sets a record for most in a WBC tournament, breaking Mexico's mark at the 2009 tournament. Junior Caminero hits solo home run, giving Dominican Republic early lead over United States Mar 15, 2026 - 8:04p ET USA or Dominican Republic? A-Rod, Jeter, Papi Make Their Picks The Captain is going with Team USA, saying that Paul Skenes will help shut down that potent D.R. lineup with five innings of work.What about A-Rod and Papi?Mar 15, 2026 - 7:59p ET 'I'm Glad I Never Had to Face You' What makes Paul Skenes' pitching repertoire so potent? The NL Cy Young winner breaks down his devastating slider with MLB on FOX analyst Alex Rodriguez. Needless to say, the MLB great is glad to have never had to stare down Skenes from the plate. Mar 15, 2026 - 7:55p ET Skenes to A-Rod: 'Proudest I’ve Ever Been Wearing a Jersey' Team USA pitcher tells MLB on FOX analyst Alex Rodriguez about the unique opportunity of representing the country at the WBC.Mar 15, 2026 - 7:17p ET Starting lineups for Team USA and the Dominican Republic The Americans have made a few noteworthy changes to their lineup.Alex Bregman is out at third base, where Gunnar Henderson will start tonight. Will Smith also got the nod behind the plate in place of Cal Raleigh.The Domincan lineup is about as expected, with major-league stars all over the place and Luis Severino on the mound.
